timing_scope: 24 cached decoded 1080p video frames repeated; full/reuse includes preprocessing, RKNN IO/run and final boxes. No video decoding, disk reading, HDMI, display or mouse. Throughput is concurrent completed frames/elapsed wall time.

conversion.quantization_recipe: Toolkit default normal/minmax, matching prior YOLO320x192

sampled_ground_truth_audit.description: Independent audit against existing ground-truth labels for the 12 held-out validation images. No board or GPU task was started.
sampled_ground_truth_audit.matching: Sort predictions by descending confidence; for each prediction choose the highest-IoU unmatched same-class ground-truth box; match if IoU >= 0.5. Single class ball=0. Report TP, FP, FN at this operating point, not mAP.
sampled_ground_truth_audit.coordinate_system: GT normalized xywh -> original pixels -> same 640x640 centered letterbox used by PT and RKNN. Predictions are already 640 canvas xyxy.
interpretation: 12 held-out labeled images contain 33 ball annotations. PT: 33 TP, 1 FP, 0 FN; INT8: 33 TP, 3 FP, 0 FN at confidence 0.25 and IoU 0.5.

The one missing INT8 detection relative to PT, sample31, is an unmatched PT box at confidence about 0.319 in background/hand area, not a missed annotated ball. All three ground-truth balls are detected by both.
The three extra INT8 predictions in validation samples26,32,33 overlap balls already detected and count as duplicate false positives.
Video sample17 is not included in this labeled-image audit. Its additional INT8 box visually corresponds to a visible ball absent from the thresholded PT output.
This is a small sampled operating-point check using existing annotations; it is not full-validation mAP, proof of generalization, or proof that quantization improves accuracy.

comparison_note: 640 vs 320x192 uses independent training from same pretrained weights, same video split and 50 epochs, batch1 INT8 Toolkit2/Runtime2.5, same test frames/clocks. One-to-one head is explicitly selected for export; training mAP is the original validation path.
